title: Judgment on the Mountains of Israel
description: The Lord sends Ezekiel with a prophecy against the mountains of Israel and their high places. He promises to destroy the idols, break down the sun pillars, and leave the corpses of the people of Israel before their idols as a sign of His judgment. Sword, famine, and plague will strike the people because of their religious corruption, but some will be spared and scattered among the nations so that they remember the Lord and know that He is God.
